rule: NES: 1 backdrop shared by both layers, 4 background palettes of 3 entries on 16x16 areas, 4 sprite palettes of 3 entries plus transparency on 8x8 tiles; every entry is a data/nes_palette.json entry number
notes: written by tools/art/make_icons_nes.py for the ICONS-NES card; no scene_icons.json existed, so this card defines it in the same format as scene_ui.json, as the card allows
backdrop $0F black is the shared backdrop, the same choice as scene_ui.json and scene_title.json
bg0 is the menu window from scene_ui.json bg0: fill $02, border and labels $30, ground band $00
sp0 gold: metal, currency, food, the two cursors
sp1 red: the potion and the gem
sp3 blue: the electronics (phone, tablet), the two prongs of steel (bident, cutlass), sleep, wet and charged
every icon uses 3 entries or fewer of its triple; the shadow icon uses 2 (black silhouette, white eyes) because a shadow is an absence of light
scene_ui.json already draws a menu cursor in sp0 [15,40,48]; the cursor icons here wear the same triple, so either art can replace the other without a palette change

a battle scene that shows an item icon must be checked against its own sprite palettes (data/palettes/scene_battle_*.json hold the battle cast); an icon is recoloured to the nearest of that scene's four triples, the drawing does not change
